mapper.select: SELECT si.category_id, ec.name, ec.code FROM student_info si JOIN exam_category ec ON ec.id = si.category_id WHERE si.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT id, name, code, type, total_score AS totalScore FROM subject ORDER BY id

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.code, s.type, s.total_score AS totalScore FROM subject s JOIN category_subject cs ON cs.subject_id = s.id JOIN student_info si ON si.category_id = cs.category_id WHERE si.user_id = #{userId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND cs.deleted = 0 AND si.deleted = 0 ORDER BY cs.sort
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_info (user_id, system_id, category_id, status) SELECT #{userId}, ec.system_id, ec.id, 1 FROM exam_category ec WHERE ec.id = #{categoryId} AND ec.status = 1
